documents.unit: Center for Excellence in Teaching and Learning (CETL)
documents.title: CETL Syllabus Template (includes Use of Generative Artificial Intelligence section)
tiers: Use of Generative AI Permitted (with or without limitations)
Use of Generative AI Not Permitted
documents.summary: An official CETL syllabus template with an optional generative AI section. The university leaves AI rules to each instructor, explains why bans are hard to enforce and detectors unreliable, and supplies two sample statements (permitted with limits, not permitted) with fill-in blanks.
documents.stance_why: The policy says "Every instructor may determine for their own class what uses of generative artificial intelligence are permissible", so the document sets no stance of its own and offers two sample statements, "Use of Generative AI Permitted (with or without limitations)" and "Use of Generative AI Not Permitted".

units.why: The statement "Every instructor may determine for their own class what uses of generative artificial intelligence are permissible" hands the decision to each instructor, so it is a per-instructor rule (P04), addressed to instructors.
